name: Westwend
source:
After a decade of running away from his past, Eric Hayes returns to his allegedly haunted hometown to pay condolences and confront his demons.

[From [url=https://veracity.itch.io/westwend]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
逃避过往整整十年后，埃里克·海斯回到了传闻中闹鬼的故乡小镇吊唁逝者，并直面自己内心的心魔。

[摘自[url=https://veracity.itch.io/westwend]itch.io[/url]]
